title: 第三章 血肉回旋阵第四章 立威上
content_zh:
被赵焚星这么一说，赵萱玲也是忧心忡忡起来。武书的苏醒，赵萱玲内心的确是高兴不已的。而如今武真的事情，真是让赵萱玲束手无策啊？近来武真遭到仇家算计，全身经脉尽断，眼下若是有人能保住其性命，赵萱玲都会感天谢地。
弟弟武真的事情，武书当然是在乎的。但赵焚星会出现在这里，武书心中疑惑也是有的。看向赵焚星，武书道，“你似乎对我们武家的事情很了解？”
赵焚星装作很无奈的道，“没办法，本小姐出门历练，一路远来，本想着会有什么奇遇之类的。一时冲动，一时好奇，便对某睡觉狂人生了兴趣。这便是拿你们武家的事情打法时间用了。不过，说真的，要不是你长得小帅，说不好本小姐早就不搭理你们武家了。世界那么大，本小姐想去看看。”
知道武书会有怀疑，赵焚星又道，“放心吧？你大可安心前去救治弟弟。如今除了你以外，你们武家可没有什么宝贝，是能让我赵焚星感兴趣的。”
赵焚星怎么看，也都是一个大美女。只是与武书说话时，谈吐举止不仅直白，还很乡里乡气的，哪点像名门望族的大家闺秀。不过想想也是，厚土大陆崇尚炼体。说不好，赵焚星纤弱的身体，在家族秘法的加持下，瞬间就能让很多炼体大汉跪地求饶呢？
想到赵焚星那时的样子，武书的小心脏便是不由一哆嗦。武书不由心道，“真不该去想这茬事。”
在武书看来，将隐患留在自己身边，才应该是强者保护亲情的最好选择，又是看向赵焚星，武书平静道，“赵大小姐，请吧！趁着这次机会，带你去见见我的爹娘。”
说起这油嘴滑舌的话，记忆之中，在遗忘大陆上，武书可从未会如此。而当着众人的面说出这样有歧义的话，武书脸不红心不跳。当然，赵焚星也不是什么腼腆人，顺着武书的话，便是道，“好的，夫君，星儿这便是陪你去拜见爹娘。”
就这样，众人就见少女挽着少年的胳膊向村外走去。
武书离去后，即便是自认见过世面的赵萱玲都是感觉事情发生的太突然，一时半会反应不过来。东土帝国赵家的人，就这般好说话，这般好骗的吗？怎么才两句话的功夫，赵焚星就成了武书的妻子了。
而想起白玉玉髓精床莫名消失的事情，一旁白发老者不由担心的提醒道，“老主人，少主如今苏醒，一旦少主在武家现身，想必帝都那边便会有动作。以老奴看来，一旦老祖宗知道了武家小少主的事情，必定会不再干预家族秘宝白玉床的事情的。”
赵萱玲平静道，“如今白玉玉髓床已经消失不见，若能看到武真安然无事，即便会死在家族手里，我心中也没有怨言了。”
老者不由跪地含泪道，“老主人长命千岁，老奴愿永远跟随在老主人身边。”
挥了挥手，示意众人退下，赵萱玲平静道，“都退下吧！我累了！”
走出大垚村没多远，武书便是将赵焚星的手从身上拿开，然后一副玩世不恭的神情道，“赵焚星，现下周围已经没有外人，有什么想说的，或者想做的，大可以放手一搏。”
在武书说话时，赵焚星也是与之拉开距离，听到武书说出这般意味深长的话，赵焚星不屑道，“武书，在苏醒后，你拥有几分实力，想必你比任何人都清楚。不说，眼下你要解决家族在东宿城及巨土镇的生存问题，即便想要治好你弟弟的伤势，也将会让你头疼一阵子。我劝你别再我面前装腔作势，即便姑奶奶我对你有任何想法。你觉得，在我面前，你有反抗之力吗？”
武书现在有何种实力，赵焚星还是能够看出来的。炼体方面，仅是炼体三重境，与普通人相比，十五六岁的时候能够拥有炼体三重的境界，已经算是非凡了，可武家以前在堃国可是拥有能够与大家族相媲美的实力的。数十年前，即便在东土帝国，说起炼器方面的大师，很多帝国强者无不是会第一时间想到堃国武家家主武尚。
武家是炼器世家，必然是格外注重炼体的。即便如今武家没落了，如武书这种武家嫡系子弟，也不该只有炼体三重的实力。
武书依旧保持着玩世不恭的态度道，“哦，是吗？看来是我想多了，像你这种出身于大家族的野马，即便在实力上被对手碾压，一旦恢复了状态，体内也有一股不服输的野望。嘁，真是个野女人。你走吧！我今天心情好，不想打女人。”
长这么大，还真没有哪个人敢当着赵焚星的面，这么羞辱她。赵焚星心里的怒火，简直能够将周围的花草树木焚烧殆尽。可想到，不论如何，现在的武书身上有太多秘密，又是曾经统治了遗忘大陆十万年的强者，赵焚星反倒是对武书更加感兴趣了。

而在赵焚星想到‘是骡子是马，牵出来溜溜就知道了。’后，赵焚星心道，“好你个武书，敢说姐是野马，打今个起，你这头野驴，姐姐驯定了。”
将心中怒火压制住，赵焚星一副脸都不要的道，“武书，再敢和姐姐废话，信不信，姐姐现在就能将你变成姐姐的人？”
赵焚星这突如其来的反向操作，直接将武书整蒙了，眼见着赵焚星一副色眯眯的走向自己，不由后退数步。而见武书后退数步，赵焚星不由乐道，“若是我刚刚愤怒的离开，你是不是还想送我一句，我希望你走的越远越好，最好是别再让我看见你。”
你走吧！走的越远越好。这句话，先前武书的确想过，要在适当的时候跟赵焚星说。
清楚知道自己猜中了武书的心思，赵焚星继续道，“武书，你虽然在遗忘大陆生活了十万年，但是你身上却有一个非常大的弱点。你对女人一点都不了解，你根本不明白，一个女人若是认定了一件事，她能够做出多么疯狂的事情来。”
别说，赵焚星没有要出手与武书一战的意思，但却让武书感觉到压力山大。
“得罪一个漂亮的女人，特别是像我这种出身高贵，高贵到一个家族足以碾压整个堃国的漂亮女人，后果将会是非常严重的。”
语言上的交锋，武书完全不是赵焚星的对手，无奈武书只能恢复高冷的神情，平静道，“赵大小姐，你我二人的恩怨，只算是你我之间的事情。若是真到了生灵涂炭的地步，我并不介意让东土帝国从厚土大陆上消失。即便是要付出，我无法承受的代价。”
言语上落败，为了不让赵焚星成为自己成长道路上的隐患，武书发自内心的说出自己的决心。
现在的武书拥有几分实力，赵焚星并不能完全确定，但赵焚星清楚，若是武书不顾及安危，非要与东土帝国不死不休，武书将会是一个极度危险的存在。
圣印，道纹，鬼门，魔像，不动明王印，玄意；如此繁琐的阵法，武书都能够掌握。若是武书的精神力足够强大，即便是东土帝国，在他面前也只算是蝼蚁般的存在。
又是上前一把挽住武书的胳膊，就好像刚刚什么都没有发生，赵焚星道，“日后事情会不会发生到这一步，这一切都要看你以后的表现咯。若真是哪天家族及那些仰慕我的同辈，看着我哭着鼻子回去。就算我不说，是你欺负了本小姐，怕也会被人满大陆追杀的。”
武书不由头大了，本想着低调发育。怎么一醒来，身边就冒出个赵焚星。不行，等将弟弟的事情解决了，一定要搞清楚，赵焚星到底想从自己身上得到什么？这种小祖宗，早送走早安心，武书不由想到。
武书也不想多说什么，平静道，“大小姐，有什么赶路用的宝贝，快拿出来吧！”
赵焚星一副看傻子的表情看着武书，道，“夜行兽，出来吧！”
在听到赵焚星的召唤后，躲在林子里的夜行兽出现在二人面前，看到夜行兽后，武书才想到，在厚土大陆，堃国境内实力未达炼体七重之上的人，即便是炼器师，也不可以借用器具飞行。当然，有头有脸的达官贵人除外。
“走吧！”
赵焚星已经坐在夜行兽背上，武书却是意味深长的冲着一侧的草丛道，“武左武右，在一旁偷听了这么久，是不是还没商量好，接下来该如何一洗前耻，好从我这赢回尊严呢？”
content_en:
When Zhao Fenxing said this, Zhao Xuanling also became worried. Zhao Xuanling was indeed overjoyed at Wu Shu's awakening. But now Wu Zhen's matter really leaves Zhao Xuanling at a loss what to do? Recently, Wuzhen was plotted by his enemies and all his meridians were severed. If anyone could save his life now, Zhao Xuanling would be grateful.
Of course Wu Shu cares about his younger brother Wu Zhen. But Zhao Fenxing would appear here, and Wu Shu also had some doubts in his heart. Looking at Zhao Fenxing, Wu Shu said, "You seem to know a lot about our Wu family's affairs?"
Zhao Fenxing pretended to be helpless and said, "I have no choice. I went out to practice and came all the way. I thought there would be some adventure or something. On impulse and curiosity, I became interested in a sleeping maniac. This is how I used my time to play with your martial arts family. But to be honest, if you weren't so handsome, I might have ignored your martial arts family. The world is so big, I want to see it."
Knowing that Wu Shu would be suspicious, Zhao Fenxing said again, "Don't worry? You can go and save your brother with peace of mind. Apart from you, there is no treasure in your Wu family that can interest me, Zhao Fenxing."
No matter how you look at it, Zhao Fenxing is a beautiful woman. But when talking to Wu Shu, his conversation and behavior were not only straightforward, but also very rural, not at all like a lady from a famous family. But think about it, the Houtu Continent advocates body training. It's hard to say, but Zhao Fenxing's delicate body, with the blessing of the family's secret method, can make many body-refining men kneel down and beg for mercy in an instant?
Thinking of Zhao Fenxing's appearance at that time, Wu Shu's little heart couldn't help but tremble. Wu Shu couldn't help but said, "I really shouldn't think about this."
In Wu Shu's view, keeping hidden dangers by his side is the best choice for a strong man to protect his family. Looking at Zhao Fenxing again, Wu Shu said calmly, "Miss Zhao, please! Take this opportunity to take you to meet my parents."
Speaking of such glib words, in my memory, Wu Shu had never been like this in the Forgotten Continent. But when Wu Shu said such ambiguous words in front of everyone, his face did not turn red and his heart did not beat. Of course, Zhao Fenxing was not a shy person. Following Wu Shu's words, he said, "Okay, husband, Xing'er will accompany you to visit your parents."
Just like that, everyone saw the girl holding the boy's arm and walking out of the village.
After Wu Shu left, even Zhao Xuanling, who thought she had seen the world, felt that things happened too suddenly and she couldn't react for a while. Are the people from the Zhao family of the Eastern Earth Empire so easy to talk to and so easy to deceive? Why did Zhao Fenxing become Wu Shu's wife in just two sentences?
Thinking of the inexplicable disappearance of the white jade chalcedony bed, the white-haired old man on the side couldn't help but worry and reminded, "Old master, the young master is awake now. Once the young master shows up in the Wu family, there will be action in the imperial capital. From the old slave's point of view, once the ancestors know about the young master of the Wu family, they will definitely stop interfering with the family's secret treasure, the white jade bed."
Zhao Xuanling said calmly, "Now that the white chalcedony bed has disappeared, if I can see that Wuzhen is safe and sound, even if he dies at the hands of his family, I will have no complaints in my heart."
The old man couldn't help but kneel down and said with tears, "My old master will live a thousand years, and this slave will always be by his side."
After waving her hand to signal everyone to step back, Zhao Xuanling said calmly, "Everyone, please step back! I'm tired!"
Not far out of Dayao Village, Wu Shu took Zhao Fenxing's hand away from his body and said with a cynical expression, "Zhao Fenxing, there are no outsiders around now. If you have anything to say or want to do, you can give it a go."
When Wu Shu was talking, Zhao Fenxing also distanced himself from him. When he heard Wu Shu say such meaningful words, Zhao Fenxing said disdainfully, "Wushu, after waking up, you must have some strength. You must know better than anyone else. Don't tell me, now you have toSolving the family's survival problem in Dongsu City and Jutu Town will give you a headache for a while even if you want to cure your brother's injury. I advise you to stop pretending in front of me, even if I have any thoughts about you. Do you think you have the strength to resist in front of me? "
Zhao Fenxing can still see what kind of strength Wu Shu has now. In terms of body refining, he is only at the third level of body refining. Compared with ordinary people, being able to reach the third level of body refining at the age of fifteen or sixteen is already considered extraordinary. However, the Wu family used to have strength comparable to that of the big families in Kun country. Decades ago, even in the Eastern Earth Empire, when talking about masters of weapon refining, many powerful people in the empire would immediately think of Wu Shang, the head of the Kun Kingdom Wu family.
The Wu family is a family that refines weapons, so it must pay special attention to body training. Even if the Wu family is now in decline, direct descendants of the Wu family such as Wu Shu should not only have the strength of the third level of body training.
Wu Shu still maintained a cynical attitude and said, "Oh, really? It seems that I have overthought it. Even if a wild horse like you, who comes from a big family, is crushed by an opponent in terms of strength, once he recovers, he still has an ambition that refuses to admit defeat. What a wild woman. You go! I'm in a good mood today and don't want to hit a woman. "
At this age, no one dared to humiliate her like this in front of Zhao Fenxing. The anger in Zhao Fenxing's heart could almost burn the surrounding flowers, plants and trees. It can be expected that no matter what, there are too many secrets in Wu Shu now, and he is a powerful man who has ruled the Forgotten Continent for a hundred thousand years. Zhao Fenxing is more interested in Wu Shu.
And when Zhao Fenxing thought, 'It's a mule or a horse, just take it out and run around and you will know. ’ After that, Zhao Fenxing thought to himself, “You’re such a martial artist, you dare to say that my sister is a wild donkey. From now on, my sister has tamed this wild donkey like you. "
Suppressing the anger in his heart, Zhao Fenxing said shamelessly, "Wushu, if you dare to talk nonsense with me again, believe it or not, my sister can turn you into my sister now? "
Zhao Fenxing's sudden reverse operation directly blinded Wu Shu. Seeing Zhao Fenxing walking toward him with a look of lust, he couldn't help but take a few steps back. Seeing Wu Shu take a few steps back, Zhao Fenxing couldn't help but said happily, "If I just left angrily, would you still want to say something to me, I hope you go as far away as possible, and it's best not to let me see you again. "
You go! The further you go, the better. Wu Shu had indeed thought about this before and said it to Zhao Fenxing at the appropriate time.
Knowing clearly that he had guessed Wu Shu's thoughts, Zhao Fenxing continued, "Wushu, although you have lived in the Forgotten Continent for a hundred thousand years, you have a very big weakness. You don’t know anything about women. You don’t understand how crazy things a woman can do if she decides on one thing. "
Needless to say, Zhao Fenxing had no intention of fighting Wu Shu, but it made Wu Shu feel a lot of pressure.
"To offend a beautiful woman, especially a beautiful woman like me who is of noble birth and whose family is so noble that it can crush the entire Kun Kingdom, the consequences will be very serious. "
In the verbal confrontation, Wu Shu was no match for Zhao Fenxing, but Wu Shu could only regain his cold expression and said calmly, "Miss Zhao, the grudge between you and me is only a matter between you and me. If it really comes to the point of devastation, I don't mind letting the Eastern Earth Empire disappear from the thick earth continent. Even if it means paying a price, I can't bear it. "
Defeated in words, Wu Shu expressed his determination from the bottom of his heart in order to prevent Zhao Fenxing from becoming a hidden danger on his growth path.
Zhao Fenxing is not completely sure about how much strength Wu Shu has now, but Zhao Fenxing knows that if Wu Shu ignores his safety and insists on fighting the Eastern Tu Empire to the death, Wu Shu will be an extremely dangerous existence.
Holy Seal, Dao Mark, Ghost Gate, Golem, Fudo Mingwang Seal, Xuanyi; such complicated formations can be mastered by martial arts. If Wu Shu's mental power was strong enough, even the Eastern Earth Empire would be nothing more than an ant-like existence in front of him.
He stepped forward and took Wu Shu's arm again. As if nothing happened just now, Zhao Fenxing said, "Whether things will happen to this point in the future depends on your future performance. If one day my family and my peers who admire me look at me and go back crying. Even if I don't tell you, you bullied me, I'm afraid you will be hunted down by people all over the continent."
Wu Shu couldn't help but feel overwhelmed, he originally wanted to develop in a low-key manner. Why did Zhao Fenxing appear next to him as soon as he woke up? No, after the brother's matter is resolved, we must find out what Zhao Fenxing wants from him? This kind of little ancestor should be sent away as soon as possible, Wu Shu couldn't help but think.
Wu Shu didn't want to say anything more and said calmly, "Miss, if you have any treasures for traveling, please take them out quickly!"
Zhao Fenxing looked at Wu Shu with an expression that looked like a fool and said, "Nocturnal beast, come out!"
After hearing Zhao Fenxing's call, the night beast hiding in the forest appeared in front of the two of them. After seeing the night beast, Wu Shu thought that in the Houtu Continent, people in the Kun Kingdom whose strength did not reach the seventh level of body refining, even the weapon refiners, could not borrow equipment to fly. Of course, except for high-ranking officials and dignitaries.
"Let's go!"
Zhao Fenxing was already sitting on the back of the night beast, but Wu Shu said meaningfully to the grass on one side, "Wu Zuo Wu You, you have been eavesdropping for so long. Have you not yet discussed it? How can you wash away your shame and win back your dignity from me?"
